subject: zoology_2
question_text: Name the yellow mass of cells accumulated in the empty follicle after ovulation. Name the hormone secreted by it and what is its function?

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.54, VSAQ 103. page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The yellow mass
steps.why: The follicle does not disappear after releasing the ovum: it turns into a temporary gland.
common_mistakes: Naming the graafian follicle. That is what it was before ovulation.
Calling it corpus albicans, which is what it becomes later.
lines: After ovulation the empty follicle fills
with a yellow mass of glandular cells

steps.label: Its hormone and function
steps.why: Progesterone keeps the uterine lining in place, so the pregnancy can only continue while it is being made.
common_mistakes: Naming oestrogen as the chief hormone here. It is progesterone.
steps.memory_tip: Progesterone is pro-gestation: it keeps the pregnancy.
steps.margin_note: Hormone and function on one line each.

insider_note: Three things are asked in one line: the structure, its hormone, and the function. Answer all three or the mark is halved.
